name: common-externals
description: Shared vendor libraries in ESM (browser module loadable) that need to be bundled with tiki

devDependenciesComment.@dicebear/collection: Used by src/js/avatar-generator.  Pinned to a set version.  Do NOT upgrade without reading the note in path_js_importmap_generator.php.
devDependenciesComment.@zxing/library: Used by both wikiplugin_totp.  Note that transitively, tiki-html5-qrcode.js uses a fork of it)
devDependenciesComment.dompurify: Warning, resolve version override set.  See main package.json Changelog: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/releases
devDependenciesComment.moment: A lot of libraries depend on this
devDependenciesComment.sortablejs: Used by legacy js code menubuilder and structures, not just newer libraries like kanban, so needs to be able to be independently included.  Dependency of https://github.com/SortableJS/Vue.Draggable which sadly hasn't moved in 2 years and is stuck at 1.14.0.  Pinning so we don't have a different version in the workspace from the global.  Otherwise dynamic module loading would make it hard to tell.
devDependenciesComment.svgedit: version 7.4.1 fixes jspdf security vulnerabilities (GHSA-8mvj-3j78-4qmw, GHSA-f8cm-6447-x5h2) Used by tiki-svgedit_draw.js
